bio.text: Teddy Reese, a Democrat, has represented Georgia House District 140 since January 9, 2023, and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for Georgia Senate District 15.
According to Ballotpedia, he was born in Gordon, Georgia, and lives in Columbus.
He earned degrees from Albany State University (2003), Georgia College & State University (2005) and the Florida A&M University College of Law (2012).

He has worked as an attorney and as director of community operations and affairs at the Georgia Appleseed Center for Law & Justice, and was national chair of the American Bar Association Law Student Division.
